title: Hidden Color · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Hidden Color · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead writes the name of a common color without showing it. The others ask up to five yes-or-no questions about the color, then make one guess. The guess matches the written color. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Hidden Color, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The guess matches the written color.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The guess matches the written color.
